title: ISO 8062-3:2023 — GPS dimensional and geometrical tolerances and machining allowances for castings
locator: General dimensional/geometrical tolerances and machining allowance grades for castings in cast metals and alloys; linear dimensions plus straightness, flatness, roundness, parallelism, perpendicularity, symmetry and coaxiality; does not cover all geometrical tolerances or un-dimensioned 3D CAD models.
notes: 铸件图纸必须明确引用标准并给出适用公差/加工余量类别；该标准不是铸件缺陷验收规范，也不自动提供床身加工余量的设计值。标准全文未下载/归档。
